text:
Alex: dropped a quick mock — compare table with dense filters on the left and a compact row mode. noticed during review: performance badges overlap the version pin in narrow widths. screenshot: https://figma.redwood/compact-compare-2.png
Marcy: can you paste the small/medium/compact frames inline? single link loses the cuteness.
Alex: pasted images inline (compact / medium / roomy). compact is default for large catalogs in the mock.
Devin: first reaction — badges are info-dense but we should never let them affect core affordances like pin. options: 1) move badges to a trailing metrics column, 2) collapse to icons in compact, or 3) make pin a fixed column.
Priya: accessibility: pin needs aria-pressed + aria-label that reads "Pin version X" and a 2px visible focus ring. In compact mode the hit target shrinks; please keep min-touch-size 44px for pointer/touch.
Jordi: metric text gets truncated mid-token: we render `p50 21ms · cost $0.004` and it clips awkwardly. Prefer icon + short tooltip for compact rows. Also badge color palette fails contrast at 12px — run contrast tests.
Sam: tallying tradeoffs: icons reduce width but add discoverability burden; fixed pin column simplifies interactions but could reduce horizontal space for metrics. I prefer icon collapse + tooltip for compact, fixed column for medium/roomy.
Alex: quick CSS idea I tried: ```css
.compare-row { min-height: 40px; }
.metrics-cell { width: 120px; text-overflow:ellipsis; }
.pin-cell { position: sticky; right: 12px; background: var(--bg); }
```
Marcy: sticky in tables is delicate cross-browser. file a compat ticket if we go that route. Also add a small microcopy change: tooltip from "Pin version" -> "Pin version for this comparison".
Devin: product question: are pins global (across comparisons) or per-comparison? I think per-comparison by default; add a "Save as default" action to persist.
Priya: please add keyboard shortcut `p` to toggle pin when row-focused and announce "Version X pinned for comparison" for screen readers. update keyboard help modal.
Jordi: propose a compact toggle in header: Compact / Comfortable. And a setting to "Preserve pinned column" that turns the pin into a dedicated left/right column. We'll test with users.
Sam: I'll add analytics events: `catalog.view_density_changed`, `catalog.pin_toggled`, `catalog.metrics_collapsed`. Will wire experiment to measure pin discovery time and misclicks.
Alex: ui-bot: staging preview deployed https://staging.redwood/compare (build #501). Feature flags: `compare.density` and `compare.pin_column` (off). Please validate keyboard flows and mobile stacked layout. :rocket:
ui-bot: deploy note: build 501 includes compact icon metrics + pin column prototype behind flags.
Marcy: next actions: Alex to refine mock for preserved-pin column fallback, Priya to write A11y acceptance checklist, Sam to add events and A/B plan, Devin to open cross-browser sticky/compat ticket. Sync Thu. :calendar:
